name: mfa_test_access_keyring_routes
description: S8a unit 01: typed and saved-connection sign-in over a foothold and over `from`, before any S8a engine edit.

scenario.scenario_brief:
TEST: Credential keyring (K1)

A test floor for the credential keyring (CREDENTIAL_KEYRING_PLAN.md, slice K1). Everything here is read by GET /keyring, the server-only answer that lists the credentials you have earned. Four proofs: take HB-FIN-02.rdp from the lobby (a held saved connection); sign in at Lena's PC in finance, east (a found password for Jake appears); read Ian's capture card in the comms room, north (his account is captured, with its value); plant the drop box in the comms port (a foothold-proof saved connection for Ian appears). K2 to K5 add the sign-in branch, the UI, the relay and tokens.
scenario.endGoal: Test only: earn each K1 proof and watch GET /keyring fill.

startItemsInInventory.observations: Your engagement device: every sign-in you have captured or found, and the PINs, footholds and findings you record.

objectives.title: Watch the keyring fill
objectives.description: Test only. Each proof the server reads adds an entry to GET /keyring.

K1b: sign in at Lena's PC (Jake's found password appears)

K3c: read the vendor contract on Jake's PC (reachable only by remote assist)

objects.observations: A small grey box with a network port and a status light. It plugs into a wall port.

objects.name: HB-FIN-02.rdp
objects.text: Saved connection to HB-FIN-02 (Lena Fox). Double-click to connect. (K1a: taking this lists the saved connection on your keyring.)
objects.observations: A saved remote-desktop connection file for HB-FIN-02.

objects.name: Capture card: stationery cupboard
objects.observations: A test card for the capture log: a PIN seen over a shoulder.
objects.text:
CAPTURE CARD (test)

Reading this records the stationery cupboard keypad PIN, seen over a shoulder. It is a PIN, not an account's password, so it shows under Captures and not under Sign-ins.

objects.name: Sign: Start here
objects.text:
Four K1 proofs. Take HB-FIN-02.rdp here (K1a). Finance is east: sign in at Lena's PC (K1b). The comms room is north: read Ian's card (K1c) and plant the drop box in the wall port (K1d).
GET /keyring lists what you have earned; it starts empty.
objects.observations: A sign on a stand by the front desk.

objects.name: Spare wall port
objects.jackConfirm: Plug the drop box into this port?
objects.requiresItemHint: A spare network port. Something small could be plugged in here.
objects.observations: A spare network port on the wall, with a patch cable tucked beside it.

objects.name: SV-OPS-01
objects.observations: A rack server on the server network. It takes a typed password only.

objects.name: Capture card: Ian
objects.observations: A test card for the capture log.
objects.text:
CAPTURE CARD (test)

Reading this records Ian's sign-in. With the drop box planted in the wall port, his account is captured and his password shows on the keyring (revealSecret is on).

objects.name: Sign: K1c and K1d
objects.text:
K1c: read Ian's capture card in this room; his account is captured and his password shows on the keyring.
K1d: plant the drop box in this wall port. A saved connection for Ian (SV-OPS-01) then appears on the keyring, proved by the foothold.
objects.observations: A sign by the wall port.

addCapture.note: Read off Ian's card in the comms room.

objects.name: Lena's PC
objects.observations: Lena's workstation. Her sign-in is on a sticky note on the screen.

contents.name: passwords.txt
contents.text:
Shared sign-ins (do not circulate).

Jake: jbrooks / Vault-Jake-4

(K1b: once you are signed in here, Jake's found password appears on your keyring.)
contents.observations: A plain-text file of shared sign-ins, left on Lena's desktop.

objects.name: Sign: Jake's office
objects.text:
K3c. Jake's office is east. The door is locked and the key stays with Jake; he will not give it up.
Through the glass panel: a PC labelled HB-FIN-03. Its remote sign-in is off, so the only way onto it is the remote assist code Jake can be talked into giving (ask him on the helpdesk's behalf).
objects.observations: A laminated sign by the glass panel in Jake's office door. HB-FIN-03 shows through the glass.

objects.name: Sign: K1b
objects.text:
K1b. Sign in at Lena's PC with the sticky note (lfox / Ledger-Lena-9). Her desktop holds passwords.txt.
With the session held here, GET /keyring lists Jake's password, found in passwords.txt (no value: you read the file).

itemsHeld.name: Remote assist code
itemsHeld.text: Remote assist code from Jake Brooks (HB-FIN-03). Connect it from your inventory to join his session.

itemsHeld.name: Jake's office key
itemsHeld.observations: The key to Jake's office. Jake keeps it on him and never hands it over in this test.

eventMappings.bark: I've ended that session. The helpdesk never calls me back.

objects.name: Jake's PC
objects.observations: Jake's workstation. Remote sign-in is off, and the room stays locked, so the only way on is his remote assist session.

contents.name: vendor_contract.txt
contents.text:
Vendor contract, Harbour Supplies Ltd (draft).

Payment terms 30 days. Renewal signed off by Jake Brooks.

(K3c: only reachable over remote assist. Reading this completes the last task and starts the invite timer.)
contents.observations: A contract file on Jake's desktop.

contents.name: meeting_notes.txt
contents.text:
Team meeting notes.

Agenda: office move, printer rota, lunch order.
contents.observations: A plain notes file in Jake's Documents folder.
